kids.name: value-4

kids.name: value-1

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: §5.3 L169: the OS turned reduce motion and increase contrast off while the screen is open. The contrast row follows the system: its Effective line updates in place to "Effective: Off, the product default" and the status region (ASS:74) is replaced with "Your system setting changed: increased contrast is now off." (W-15), spoken once, politely

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: The motion row holds an explicit On: it stays ("Effective: On, your choice", W-13) and shows W-16 "Your system now asks for off; your choice of On stays." — visible text only, never in the status region (R-4)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: A second flip inside the polite cadence replaces the pending text, latest wins (`05`:151; PROPOSED)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: The explicit On is a modified row (§10): "Changed" and its "Reset" button (W-24)

kids.name: value-1

kids.name: value-2

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: T2 anatomy (E09-D09 §2.2): the lock glyph (CMP-019, name "Not available") leads the full label, both in color.text.tertiary; the group's fill color.surface.raised with a color.border.default hairline; the reason under the control in color.text.secondary; never color.text.disabled or opacity.disabled

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: aria-disabled="true" on every radio, never disabled: the group stays in the Tab order (drawn focused, CMP-039 normal); Enter / Space change nothing and re-show the reason with one polite announcement; the arrows move the roving focus without checking (PROPOSED)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: The stored choice (Follow my system) stays visible on its radio and returns when forced colours end (R-4); aria-describedby order: description, Effective line, reason

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: Drawn in the dark token set: under forced colours the system maps the carriers (§11: the ring a solid Highlight outline, the lock glyph and tile frame CanvasText, the checked radio Highlight)

the motion tile's accessible name "Motion preview, full motion: the heatmap trail fades, the price flashes": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)

Board 04 frame 2: §5.3 shows the in-place update (a following row) and W-16 (an explicit row) but W-16's words are fixed ("…asks for off; your choice of On stays"): drawn as one OS change that turns both signals off — the contrast row follows (W-15, its line updated), the motion row keeps its explicit On (W-16); an explicit contrast On would switch the theme to high contrast, so the explicit row is motion
Effective lines with no OS preference read "the product default" (W-14): the kit reads "no-preference" as no OS signal (§5.1's override ?? OS signal ?? default)

T2 label colour (design-read minor): §5.4 and E09-D09 §2.2 put the T2 label and its lock in color.text.tertiary; §11's "labels color.text.primary" is read as the enabled rows' rule — drawn tertiary on the forced-colours contrast row only
